apps.name: iTorrent
apps.subtitle: Torrent client for iOS
apps.localizedDescription:
iTorrent officially in the AltStore!

It is an ordinary torrent client for iOS with Files app support and much more.

What can this app do:

• Download in the background
• Live Activity and Dynamic Island progress bar
• Downloading on external drives
• Sequential download (use VLC to watch films while loading)
• Add torrent files from Share menu (Safari and other apps)
• Add magnet links directly from Safari
• Store files in Files app
• File sharing directly from app
• Download torrent by url
• Download torrent by magnet
• Show progress in Dynamic Island
• Send notification on torrent downloaded
• Web/WebDav Server
• Select files download priority
• Change UI to dark theme
• Color personalization
• RSS Feed

apps.name: PostBox
apps.subtitle: The latest jailbreak news at your fingertips
apps.localizedDescription:
• A pool of feeds. Enjoy a lively feed of various sources to always stay connected with the jailbreak scene. Sources are updated frequently so you don't miss out!

• Powered externally. PostBox enables support for third-party jailbreak sources such as r/jailbreak and iDownloadBlog. More content will be coming soon in the future.

• Repositories are libraries of packages. PostBox contains over 200 repos for centralization and provides a system for efficient repo finding. You can now effortlessly look for information that will previously require painstaking work.

• Review packages. The ability to review packages creates new opportunities for users and developers alike. Any package can be reviewed regardless of repository or depiction differences.

apps.name: Angel Aura Amethyst
apps.subtitle: Bringing Minecraft: Java Edition to mobile devices.
apps.localizedDescription:
THESE BUILDS WILL NOT AUTOMATICALLY UPDATE AND YOU WILL NOT RECEIVE ANY NOTIFICATIONS FOR SUCH (at least, right now. I'm working on it.). Angel Aura Amethyst is a Minecraft: Java Edition launcher for iOS based on the PojavLauncher project.

• Play most versions of Minecraft, from the very first beta to the latest snapshots.
• Customize with mods, resource packs, and compatible shaders
• Create multiple instances of Minecraft for multiple versions
• Adjust on-screen controls to your liking, or use keyboard and mouse or controllers
• Play online with full Java Edition servers
...and so much more!

Notice: Amethyst requires JIT to function correctly. This application automatically enables JIT with AltServer, TrollStore, or when jailbroken, however other methods can be used if required.
